_comment: The country list the monitor tracks. Edit freely. 'fips' are GDELT ActionGeo country codes (FIPS 10-4: where an event happens); 'cameo' are actor country codes (who is involved). An event counts for a country if either matches. 'news' is a Google News search string. 'gdelt' is a GDELT DOC query used only for the outbound 'GDELT live article list' link. 'atlas' is the map name. 'tier' is 'operates' or 'dialogue'.
